subject.title: fix(xai): apply request policy to video generation requests

question: Should xAI video polling and generated-media downloads become SSRF-guarded by default, with private-network access permitted only through explicit `cfg.models.providers.xai.request.allowPrivateNetwork: true`, even though this can stop previously working private or custom-endpoint flows?
rationale: The code defect and repair are clear, but replacing an unguarded fallback with fail-closed behavior changes the security and upgrade contract for existing installations; repository policy requires explicit owner intent for that boundary.

options.title: Adopt Default-Deny Guarding
options.body: Confirm the PR's guarded behavior across create, poll, and download, requiring explicit private-network opt-in for affected custom deployments.

options.title: Preserve Legacy Poll/Download Access
options.body: Retain the old unguarded later-stage behavior until a separate compatibility or migration design is approved, accepting the existing SSRF exposure in the interim.

recommendation.title: Adopt Default-Deny Guarding
recommendation.body: Confirm the PR's guarded behavior across create, poll, and download, requiring explicit private-network opt-in for affected custom deployments.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent provider HTTP request-policy and SSRF-related work is the closest historical ownership signal for this boundary.
